name: Western India Plywoods Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1945, Western India Plywoods Ltd is a manufacturer of Wood based products including Hardboard, Plywood, and Compreg[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview[1][2]
WIPL manufactures Saw Timber and Plywood related panel products viz. Block boards, Flush door, Shuttering and Marine Plywood, Aircraft Plywood, Densified Wood, etc. It has an integrated wood complex, and their integrated nature of operations enables them to use the same raw material, viz. firewood, timber logs and veneer to manufacture different end products based on market and customer requirement

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 22.2%
cons: Stock is trading at 3.07 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 3.62% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 7.79% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
